instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the voice assistant SECU speaks and supports both English and Hinglish mode.
Include simulated Web Speech API / TTS / Speech-to-Text hooks with graceful fallbacks so the user can speak via browser microphone or type in the input bar on the touchscreen.
Ensure SECU avatar smoothly transitions between IDLE, LISTENING, THINKING, and SPEAKING states with clear visual badge and wave colors.
Implement data persistence (localStorage / mock backend) for leads captured so they instantly appear in the Admin Dashboard table.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes for automated test validation.
Use lucide-react icons and recharts for admin dashboard analytics.
Keep touchscreen kiosk UX ultra-responsive with large buttons (min 48px height) and touch-friendly drawers/modals.
